ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Cases
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and connections between entities involved in the Feeding Our Future scheme and other Minnesota fraud cases
questions: What are the financial connections between the entities involved?
How much money was involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money will reveal more about the scope and connections between these cases. By analyzing financial transactions and connections, we may be able to identify other entities or individuals involved.
